name: chicco.pt
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.chicco.pt scores 58 out of 100 (D). 10 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 32 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /sobre-nos.html, /lojas, /servicos.html and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Cookiebot was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies _ga, _ga_6N47X4797N.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /sobre-nos.html, /lojas, for example .navbar-nav. Impact: critical.

fix.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 16 elements on /, for example .tns-slide-cloned.einstein-carousel-item[aria-hidden="true"]:nth-child(1) and .tns-slide-cloned.einstein-carousel-item[aria-hidden="true"]:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Remove focusable elements from aria-hidden containers, or drop aria-hidden.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Cookies Necessárias" and reloading, Google Ads (4 requests), and new cookies _ga_XXXXXXXXXX still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 683 ms
Every page has a meta description
